description: Build the schema-v2 TipTap youtube node for one pasted YouTube URL, entirely locally — no network call and no writes. Accepts watch, youtu.be, Shorts, live, embed, and /v/ URLs with a SINGLE optional t=/start= offset. STRICT rejection: playlists (list=), autoplay, tracking params (si, feature, pp, utm_*), any other query params or fragments, path suffixes after the id, both t and start together, channel URLs, non-YouTube hosts, and raw <iframe>/embed HTML. Documents persist only the exact 11-char videoId, and the returned youtube-nocookie embed URL is the only embed instruction surfaces render. The default stable id is collision-safe and unique per call; pass nodeId for reproducible documents. Placing the node requires the page’s contentSchemaVersion >= 2 (see schema_upgrade).
name: opentrain_job_instructions_youtube_node
